title: UAE Charter for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Emphasizes privacy, transparency, human oversight, safety, fairness and accountability. This record summarizes guidance; it does not determine legal applicability or assistance eligibility.
section: Data Privacy; Transparency; Human Oversight; Governance and Accountability

title: WHO guidance on AI in health: six guiding principles
summary: Supports human control, privacy and confidentiality, meaningful documentation, accountability, equity and safety in health-related AI. This is guidance, not an authorization to determine a person’s eligibility.
section: Protecting human autonomy; transparency; responsibility and accountability
